Image 1 is the exact identity/edit target: a squat front-facing mechanical armored unit in three static phases, pale silver-white rectangular box helmet, angled white top plate, large featureless black visor opening under a horizontal metal brow, chunky silver shoulder side plates, black joint recesses, short mechanical arms/hands, compact waist and two broad metal feet. Preserve this silhouette, all armor shapes, original white/silver/dark gray palette and FRONT view in every cell. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY: approved finely hand-painted chibi robot group 52, use its smooth ink contours, shaded metal planes and small material detail; do NOT copy its rust-brown armor, circular side ear, visible yellow eyes, four directions or gait. Redraw Image 1 at genuinely high illustration resolution with clean hand-painted linework and subtle silver metal shading, no pixel blocks or nearest-neighbor enlargement. Exactly ONE ROW, THREE equal-width cells, one complete figure centered in each cell, same scale, feet on identical baseline, generous equal transparent padding. These are static idle phases, never walking: middle and right differ only slightly in arm settling and reflected light consistent with the source strip. All three remain frontal, visually same identity. Truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background, no black matte, white matte, checkerboard, ground shadow or floor. No text, labels, frames, grid lines, weapons, facial eyes, antennae, ornaments, new colors, extra figures or directions. Intended extraction into three 144x144 cells; keep silhouettes complete and separated, strong readable metal edges, big helmet and short body.
